Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly simulates future land use and land cover (LULC) changes at the national scale of Bangladesh from 2010 to 2030. It implements three distinct future scenarios—baseline, ecological protection priority, and economic growth—and quantitatively compares projected changes in six land use classes (cultivated land, forest, grassland, water, built-up, unused). The study uses the Dynamics of Land Systems (DLS) model with spatially explicit 1 km resolution data, incorporates driving factors across geophysical, climatic, proximity, and socioeconomic domains, and reports quantitative outputs including area changes (km² and %), transition probabilities, and mapped projections (Figure 5). Model accuracy is validated using the Kappa coefficient (Kappa = 0.667), satisfying the requirement for quantitative accuracy metrics. The primary objective is LULC prediction, and all core inclusion criteria are met while none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
